Prevent outgoing multicast frames from looping back to the RX queue.
By introducing new HW capability self_lb_en_modifiable
the support to modify self_lb_en bit in modify_tir command.
When this capability is set we can prevent TIRs from sending back
loopback multicast traffic to their own RQs
modify_tir command
column2: on every time new channels (SQs/RQs) are created at

column1: device open.

load
column2: and the loopback decision is under their responsibility.
